text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross got injured during
training, so I've
brought her to the
infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: How come you're apologizin'? This wasn't anyone's fault, so ya can cut the doom 'n gloom.
choice_data_list: Sorry, I should've been more careful.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
'Sides,
a scratch like this'll clear up in no
time!
C'mon, cheer up!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wait a sec, I'm the one who got hurt, so how come I'm tryin' to make you feel better? You're s'posed to be cheerin' me up!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha. You're gettin' some color back
in your cheeks now. C'mon, there's still
time on the clock.
Let's get back to
trainin'!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, it's not that bad. Light injuries
like this
happen all the time.
choice_data_list: ...Got it. Let's do it, but be car...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Geez! Quit gettin' gloomy over
everythin'!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Okay fine, I'll give. Trainin' wouldn't
be fun with
you this on edge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sounding disappointed, Tamamo Cross
takes
herself back to the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
All right!
I think I'm good for a light jog!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Dang it. I think I might've made it worse.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
If I'd known this'd happen, I woulda just
listened
to ya.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After I see Tamamo Cross back to the
dorm, she
makes sure to rest up
properly.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
All right!
I think I'm good for a light jog!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I feel fine! I knew it was nothin'
serious!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her injury doesn't seem to be affecting
her very much. Being mindful of her
temporary limits,
Tamamo Cross
continues to train.
